title: Gargoyle Smasher
text: Automatically smash Gargoyles when they're on critical health, if you have the right tool.

title: Slug Salter
text: Automatically salt Rockslugs when they're on critical health, if you have salt.

title: Reptile Freezer

title: 'Shroom Sprayer
text: Automatically spray Mutated Zygomites when they're on critical health, if you have fungicide.

title: Malevolent Masquerade
text: Learn to combine the protective Slayer headgear and Slayer gem into one universal helmet, with level 55 Crafting.

title: Ring Bling
text: Learn to craft your own Slayer Rings, with level 75 Crafting.

title: Broader Fletching
text: Learn to fletch broad arrows (with level 52 Fletching), broad bolts (with level 55 Fletching) and amethyst broad bolts (with level 76 Fletching).

title: Seeing Red

title: Bigger and Badder

title: Duly Noted

title: Stop the Wyvern

title: Double Trouble
